title: Chicken Race
wikitext:
[[File:Chicken Race.png|thumb|The Chicken Race starting point.]] The '''Chicken Race''' is a race located in {{Zone|Jerry's Workshop}} next to {{NPCSprite|Gulliver}} at {{Coordinates|68|105|33}}, the player controls a {{MobSprite|Chicken}} that jumps through hoops in the sky. The race will end if the player touches the ground, or leaves the chicken (such as [[Aspect of the End]], or pressing the shift key), or the timer ends. Passing through '''cluckpoints''' increases the time on the timer, and reaching a cluckpoint for the first time will end the race and give the player a reward. The chicken race won't progress past cluckpoint 1 if the player hasn't talked to {{NPCSprite|Frosty}} yet. == Rewards == {| class="wikitable" !Cluckpoint !Time Required !Icon !Reward !Rarity !Description |- | 1 || {{Yellow|<33s}} || {{Slot|Red Gift}} || [[Red Gift]]|| {{Rare}} || Lets the user and another player both claim a reward. |- | 2 || {{Yellow|<52s}} || {{Slot|Gift Compass}} || [[Gift Compass]] || {{Uncommon}} || When held, points to the nearest {{Item|White Gift}} that hasn't been found this year. |- | 3 || {{Yellow|<68s}} || {{Slot|Frozen Chicken}} || [[Frozen Chicken]]|| {{Rare}} || +1 {{Stat|speed}}. Also grants 8 [[Accessory Power]] in the [[Accessory Bag]] as a {{Rare}} [[Accessories|Accessory]]. |- | 4 || {{Yellow|<104s}} || {{Slot|Jingle Bells}} || [[Jingle Bells]]
{{SkyBlock XP|+5}} || {{Rare}} || Angers all monsters in a 10 block range, consuming 50% of your total {{stat|mana}} and causing them to run towards you. |} == Tips == * Try to cut corners as much as possible. * Try to land on the edge of the ring, as it maximizes time. * Try not to over- or underestimate the Y-axis distance on the next ring, as either falling or jumping with no change in the X and Z-axis will cost you time. * Don't worry if the game lags, it's normal for an event, so don't be surprised if you have some freezes or if you have to pass through a ring multiple times. * Be careful not to press the space bar too much during the race, your chicken will jump randomly so you miss the rings. * The chicken moves forward automatically, you don't need to press W. Doing so may make you go slower. * When next to the lake, be careful as the fishing rods may kill the chicken. * Save as much time as possible, especially if doing the 4th cluckpoint, as you will fail with less than 1 second left if you make a simple mistake. == Trivia == * The chickens that players ride on are able to be killed which results in the player on the chicken getting reset. == History == {{History table |beta= {{History|2019/December 18|Added Chicken Race.}} }} == Navigation == {{Nav/Races}} {{Nav/Events/Season of Jerry}} [[Category:V0.7.5]]
